title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00012 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:

02:00 - 04:00: Waited for production to prepare paperwork, isolate f-4 and bleed off pressure below tree cap. Meanwhile removed damaged x-over from f-11b XT. Built lubricator on rig floor
04:00 - 07:00: Attempted to disconnect tree cap from x-over on f-4. No-go. Meanwhile opened and inspected BOP for cement
07:00 - 07:30: Removed x-over from the XT and moved same to welders shop to attempt to release tree cap from x-over
07:30 - 09:30: Release tree can from the x-over in the welders shop with help of heating
09:30 - 10:00: Installed x-over on XT on f-11b well
10:00 - 10:30: Installed lower riser and WL BOP on XT
10:30 - 11:30: Attempted to pressure test of bleed off manifold and connection on WL lower riser to XT, 20/345bar 5/10 min. Observed leak on bleed off manifold
11:30 - 12:15: Troubleshoot leak on bleed off manifold
12:15 - 12:45: Performed pressure test of bleed off manifold and connection on WL lower riser to XT, 20/345bar 5/10 min

POOH from to 2700 m
